{{Quote|Sorry, sir. Comms are down. We're making rounds. Imperial employees are to report immediately to the IOC building.|The soldier, to Syril Karn|<ref name="Who Are You?" />}}
A [[human]] '''soldier''' served the [[Galactic Empire]] and was present on the [[planet]] [[Ghorman]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. In [[2 BBY]], they notified the human [[Syril Karn]] to report to the [[Imperial office complex]] building in [[Palmo Plaza]] at once before a [[Ghorman Massacre|massacre]] was staged to begin by the Empire.<ref name="Who Are You?" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The soldier appeared in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in the series' eighth episode, "[[Who Are You?]]," which was released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="Who Are You?" /> on [[May 6]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> The soldier was portrayed [[Imani Yahshua]] and listed in the series' credits as simply "Nervous Soldier".<ref name="Who Are You?" />
